name: claims
title: Health insurance claims
description: Pharmacy bills checked against the prescription: drugs, patient, dates and quantities.

doc_types.name: prescription
doc_types.title: medical prescription
doc_types.description: a doctor's prescription (printed or handwritten) listing medicines under Rx

doc_types.name: bill
doc_types.title: pharmacy bill
doc_types.description: a pharmacy or hospital bill itemising medicines with quantity, rate and amount

checks.description: Patient name matches on both documents
Bill dated on/after the prescription, within 30 days
Billed quantity fits dose x frequency x duration

name: expenses
title: Expense reimbursement
description: Employee expense claims checked against the receipt: amount, policy window and duplicates.

doc_types.name: receipt
doc_types.title: merchant receipt
doc_types.description: a till, restaurant, fuel or travel receipt issued by a merchant

doc_types.name: expense_claim
doc_types.title: expense claim form
doc_types.description: an employee reimbursement form naming the claimant, expense and amount claimed

checks.description: Claimed amount does not exceed the receipt total
Claim expense date equals the receipt date
Receipt is within 30 days of the claim
Claim merchant matches the receipt merchant

name: payables
title: Accounts payable (invoice to PO)
description: GST invoices checked for validity and matched line by line against the purchase order.

doc_types.name: invoice
doc_types.title: GST tax invoice
doc_types.description: an Indian GST tax invoice with GSTINs, HSN codes and CGST/SGST or IGST

doc_types.name: purchase_order
doc_types.title: purchase order
doc_types.description: a purchase order issued by a buyer listing items, quantities and agreed rates

checks.description: Invoice seller GSTIN equals the PO vendor GSTIN
Every invoice line is on the PO (description + HSN)
Billed quantity does not exceed the ordered quantity
Invoice rate within 2% of the PO rate
